job: Read what shipped, newest first, and filter it by kind.
purpose: A docs page of releases on a date rail: each with its version, tags, a headline, a short body, code and an image. Chips filter by kind. The list can still be loading, can fail with Retry, or be empty before the first release.
useWhen: A product wants one place for new endpoints, SDK releases and fixes.
Readers look for one kind of change.

avoidWhen.when: The page explains how to do a task.
The page is the reference for one endpoint.
Someone needs the live health of the service.
